info.title: Fabric Activator delivery
info.description: Queue an Activator action for durable API delivery. A 202 response confirms queue acceptance, not downstream completion.

post.description: Reuse the source event/action key on every retry or flow resubmission. The complete UTF-8 request envelope must not exceed 65536 bytes.

400.description: Invalid envelope, event key, JSON payload, or gateway content validation failure.

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key or backend webhook credential.

413.description: Java intake rejected an envelope larger than 65536 bytes.

503.description: Queue acceptance was not confirmed. Retry using the same eventId.

default.description: Request failed. Never treat a gateway error or timeout as queue acceptance.

eventId.description: Opaque, globally unique source event plus action identifier, without patient data. Do not use guid(), utcNow(), or a flow run ID.

payloadJson.description: A JSON object encoded as text. Java forwards its UTF-8 bytes unchanged, without the Power Automate envelope.
